title: Tensoring with a flat module preserves exact sequences
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M$ a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. If $N_1\xrightarrow{f}N_2\xrightarrow{g}N_3$ is an exact sequence of $R$-modules ($\ker g=\operatorname{im}f$), then $N_1\otimes_RM\xrightarrow{f\otimes1}N_2\otimes_RM\xrightarrow{g\otimes1}N_3\otimes_RM$ is exact; likewise $M\otimes_RN_1\to M\otimes_RN_2\to M\otimes_RN_3$ is exact. In particular, if $0\to N_1\xrightarrow{f}N_2\xrightarrow{g}N_3$ is exact, so is $0\to N_1\otimes_RM\to N_2\otimes_RM\to N_3\otimes_RM$.
